operations.cost_description: All three seeds completed 100 epochs on one Secure Cloud RTX PRO 4500 Blackwell at US$0.72/hour. The rental lasted at most 2.799 hours including setup, benchmark, evaluation and backup. Elapsed compute is estimated at US$2.015; US$1.346 of pod and volume charges had posted at reconciliation, with billing still pending. The conservative new-run allowance is C$5.74, including conversion, fee/tax multipliers and C$1.50 storage/rounding allowance, below the C$12 cap. With C$10 reserved for previous/pending project spending, the cumulative operating envelope is C$15.74 against C$40, with C$10 contingency separate. Backups were verified before this run's pod and volume were removed. These estimates are not a final CAD invoice.
execution_events: Two direct RTX 4090 placements refused for capacity; queued request cancelled and verified without a created pod.
RTX PRO 4500 selected within the approved budget; frozen model/data/training settings unchanged.

All three seed attempts completed with finite training; all export checks passed.
